title: Reverse String in Blocks
description: Given a string `s` and positive integer `k`, process consecutive blocks of `2k` characters from left to right. In each block, reverse its first `k` characters and leave the next `k` unchanged. If fewer than `k` characters remain, reverse all of them. Input: `s`, `k`. Output: the transformed string.
hints: Track only the character counts or prefixes needed to decide the next step.
Check repeated symbols, empty or minimal cases, and impossible arrangements.
